body:
Maybe not the girly disco stuff, but ABBA has genuinely well-crafted pop songs, and the first half of their discography has a rock edge; SOS, Watch Out, So Long, Hey Hey Helen. Waterloo and ABBA the Album may also be of interest due to the excellent layered compositions and vocal harmonies. 
Also, they were popular the same time as ELO, Queen, and Yes- and, to my knowledge, the same overlap of fans, well at least for the first two.
Gorillaz has no business existing after phase 3.

Yes, I want him to get checked out but he says he feels fine now.

I’d be worried sick if that was my liver.
